objective: Definir el contrato puro de reservas provisionales y concurrencia de beneficios Cavas. Debe evitar sobreasignacion cuando dos o mas transacciones simultaneas intentan consumir el mismo saldo disponible antes de la confirmacion del POS/ERP. La disponibilidad debe descontar consumo confirmado neto mas reservas activas. Una reserva puede expirar o liberarse sin efecto economico; solo una confirmacion real del proveedor convierte la reserva en consumo confirmado. No DDL, no locks fisicos de BD, no escritura directa al POS/ERP.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitReservation, BenefitReservationCapacity, BenefitReservationStatus,
    active_reservation_amount, benefit_reservation_available_amount,
    can_reserve_benefit_amount, reservation_can_transition,
    reservation_has_economic_effect, validate_benefit_reservation,
)


def _reservation(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        reservation_id="RES-1",
        idempotency_key="APP-1|TX-1",
        policy_id="POL-1",
        policy_version="V1",
        contract_id="CTR-1",
        unit_id="UNIT-1",
        source_system="POS-CANONICAL",
        source_transaction_id="TX-1",
        amount=100.0,
        currency="MXN",
        expires_at_epoch=2000,
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return BenefitReservation(**data)


def test_available_amount_subtracts_confirmed_and_active_reservations():
    capacity = BenefitReservationCapacity(1000, 600, 250)
    assert benefit_reservation_available_amount(capacity) == 150.0


def test_concurrent_request_is_blocked_when_active_reservations_consume_balance():
    capacity = BenefitReservationCapacity(1000, 600, 350)
    assert can_reserve_benefit_amount(requested_amount=100, capacity=capacity) is False


def test_expired_reservations_do_not_hold_capacity():
    reservations = (
        _reservation(amount=100, expires_at_epoch=2000),
        _reservation(reservation_id="RES-2", amount=200, expires_at_epoch=900),
    )
    assert active_reservation_amount(reservations, now_epoch=1000) == 100.0


def test_active_reservation_must_not_be_expired():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_benefit_reservation(_reservation(expires_at_epoch=999), now_epoch=1000)


def test_reservation_has_no_economic_effect_until_consumed():
    assert reservation_has_economic_effect(_reservation()) is False
    assert reservation_has_economic_effect(_reservation(status=BenefitReservationStatus.CONSUMED)) is True


def test_terminal_reservations_cannot_be_reopened():
    assert reservation_can_transition(BenefitReservationStatus.ACTIVE, BenefitReservationStatus.CONSUMED) is True
    assert reservation_can_transition(BenefitReservationStatus.ACTIVE, BenefitReservationStatus.RELEASED) is True
    assert reservation_can_transition(BenefitReservationStatus.RELEASED, BenefitReservationStatus.ACTIVE) is False
    assert reservation_can_transition(BenefitReservationStatus.EXPIRED, BenefitReservationStatus.ACTIVE) is False
    assert reservation_can_transition(BenefitReservationStatus.CONSUMED, BenefitReservationStatus.ACTIVE) is False

constraints: NO locks fisicos ni implementacion de concurrencia de infraestructura dentro del dominio puro
La capacidad disponible resta consumo confirmado neto y reservas activas no expiradas
Una reserva ACTIVE no tiene efecto economico
RELEASED y EXPIRED liberan capacidad sin generar consumo
Solo CONSUMED representa conversion de una reserva a beneficio economicamente confirmado
La expiracion es configurable por orquestacion; no hardcodear TTL
La persistencia futura debera imponer unicidad atomica por idempotency_key/scope para cerrar carreras reales
No inventar CONSUMED sin confirmacion real del proveedor
